tests.note: halt is a GPOS width feature and must never substitute glyphs. Before the fix it applied the trad substitutions, turning kanji into traditional Chinese forms (亜->亞, 医->醫, 円->圓).
Second failure mode of the same bug: halt also pulled in the vertical .rotat substitutions, rotating Latin punctuation in horizontal text.
palt is a GPOS width feature and must never substitute glyphs. Before the fix it swapped in variant forms (唖->uni555E, 嘘->uni5653, 欝->uni6B1D.jp78).
vhal is a GPOS width feature and must never substitute glyphs. Before the fix it replaced proportional punctuation with fullwidth forms (! -> uniFF01).
vpal is a GPOS width feature and must never substitute glyphs. Before the fix it replaced proportional punctuation with fullwidth forms (! -> uniFF01).
Positive control: trad is the feature that is *supposed* to switch to traditional forms, and it must keep working after halt/palt/vhal/vpal were cleaned up.
